data.name: DRM_004
data.value: Where...[pause=30]

data.name: DRM_005
data.value: Where am I?

data.name: DRM_006
data.value: The ground makes no sound under my paws.[pause=30] This has to be a dream.

data.name: DRM_007
data.value: ...Someone's there.[pause=30] Over there,[pause=15] in the light.

data.name: DRM_008
data.value: I know that shape.[pause=30] I'm sure of it.[pause=20] Almost sure.

data.name: DRM_009
data.value: ......[pause=30] No.[pause=20] It slips away again.

data.name: DRM_010
data.value: ...There you are.

data.name: DRM_011
data.value: You came all this way.[pause=30] Just like last time.

data.name: DRM_012
data.value: Last time?[pause=30] Have we met before?

data.name: DRM_013
data.value: You don't remember.[pause=20] That's how it should be.[pause=30] It's what you asked for.

data.name: DRM_014
data.value: Asked for...?[pause=20] Me?[pause=30] But I never asked for anything.

data.name: DRM_015
data.value: Not yet.[pause=40] And yet you did.

data.name: DRM_016
data.value: Why do you come into my dreams?

data.name: DRM_017
data.value: Because it's the only place you can still hear me.

data.name: DRM_018
data.value: By day,[pause=15] there's the wind.[pause=20] The voices.[pause=20] Your friend calling you.[pause=30] By night,[pause=20] there's only you.

data.name: DRM_019
data.value: Tomorrow,[pause=15] you will climb.

data.name: DRM_020
data.value: You have climbed a height like that before.[pause=40] But not with this body.

data.name: DRM_021
data.value: ...Not with this body?[pause=30] What does that mean?

data.name: DRM_022
data.value: Up there,[pause=15] the wind will know you.[pause=40] Don't be afraid when it does.

data.name: DRM_023
data.value: And when you reach the summit...[pause=30] don't look for me.[pause=30] I will find you.

data.name: DRM_024
data.value: ......[pause=40] Day is breaking.

data.name: DRM_025
data.value: Wait —[pause=20] I didn't understand any of it![pause=30] Stay!

data.name: DRM_026
data.value: We will meet again.[pause=40] We always meet again.

data.name: DRM_000
data.value: It had been a long time,[pause=40] such a long time...

data.name: DRM_011_RUINS
data.value: We meet again.[pause=20] This is the second time you hear me.

data.name: DRM_012_RUINS
data.value: This time,[pause=15] I remember you...[pause=20] You appeared in my first dream.

data.name: DRM_013_RUINS
data.value: Yes.[pause=20] But your mind still seeks to forget.[pause=15] Do not fight your memories.

data.name: DRM_014_RUINS
data.value: My memories...?[pause=20] Who am I really... ?

data.name: DRM_015_RUINS
data.value: You will find out soon enough.[pause=40] All in due time.

data.name: DRM_019_RUINS
data.value: Tomorrow,[pause=15] you will descend into the depths.

data.name: DRM_020_RUINS
data.value: You have already explored an abyss like that one.[pause=40] But not with this body.

data.name: DRM_022_RUINS
data.value: Under the earth,[pause=15] the silence will recognize you.[pause=40] Do not fear the darkness.
